name: The Forgotten Heirloom
summary: In Westfall, The Forgotten Heirloom is a pocket watch left behind as the Furlbrows fled their farm. Recovering it gives them a chance to reclaim something personal amid the chaos.

sections.title: A Midnight Eviction
sections.body: Farmer Furlbrow and Verna were driven from their Westfall farm by violence. Shouts from the pumpkin patches woke them in the night, leaving little time to gather what they could carry. In their flight, Furlbrow left behind the pocket watch Verna's father gave him on their wedding day. It remains in the wardrobe of their occupied farmhouse.

sections.title: Hooligans in the Fields
sections.body: Defias thugs and thieves, including Benny Blaanco, now pick through the abandoned Furlbrow farm. Returning for a keepsake could mean death for ordinary folk. You can take the pocket watch from the wardrobe and restore a measure of dignity to a family that has lost nearly everything to Westfall's lawlessness.

faq.q: Why is the pocket watch so important to Farmer Furlbrow?
faq.answer: Verna's father gave Farmer Furlbrow the pocket watch on their wedding day. Now refugees who have lost their livelihood, the Furlbrows keep a sentimental link to their former life and family heritage in it.

faq.q: Who drove the Furlbrows away from their farm?
faq.answer: Defias brigands and looters drove the Furlbrows from their farm during the night. Their attack reflects the lawlessness forcing many farming families to abandon their homes and fields under threat of violence.

The pocket watch is inside a bedroom wardrobe at the Furlbrow homestead, in the pumpkin patches west of the Furlbrows' roadside camp in northern Westfall. Squatters and Defias outlaws occupy the farmhouse.

aliases: who is the guy in the house
faq.answer: Benny Blaanco is an outlaw inside the Furlbrow farmhouse with Defias companions. They ransack the abandoned home and guard it against anyone who might reclaim it.

faq.q: Where are the Furlbrows staying now?
faq.answer: Farmer Furlbrow and Verna are stranded by the roadside in Westfall. They shelter near their wagon and try to survive the region's collapse.

faq.q: Does Stormwind send guards to help recover farms like this?
faq.answer: Stormwind's official military presence in Westfall is nearly absent, amid political indifference and missing leadership in the capital. The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill lacks the strength to reclaim individual farms, leaving settlers exposed.

angles.text: The Furlbrows' plight shows how badly order has broken down in the kingdom's breadbasket. As an Alliance traveler, you are left to handle what the crown has neglected.
As a human of Stormwind, you see honest farmers driven from their land by outlaws within a day's march of the capital. Their plight reveals the kingdom's troubles at home.
